searchText: The automerge bot is documented in the README 🙂 Sometimes the bot is stuck. It could be rewritten as a github actions bot (see #2961). The reason github actions would be "easy" because they provide the bot/account aspect. With any other solution one needs to maintain some registered account to be the merging account. Yeah. Ideally we'd hire someone/bounty the rewrite. GitHub actions are powerful enough to do the job of the auto-merge. <@!301186049323958275> As you don't like Meta EIPs, let's continue the discussion about Informational EIPs here, because I think this discussion don't belongs to the EIP I'm writing. Where the EIP rules for Informational and Meta EIPs were discussed before? Why you think Informational and Meta EIPs are bad? I think Informational EIP useful. For example, the EIP I created, 3023, is important to be documented in the EIP site, because it proposes guidelines for other EIP and systems that are implementing other EIPs. i.e. information directed to anyone building wallets interfaces or wallet contracts, to follow certain good practices to solve the issue in ERC20 approve and call design, which is a common mistake currently causing millions in value loss. When someone searching about ERC20 it should appears as a document that references to ERC20. <@!551157969367334912> here is a recent discussion on the topic: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/746566142700814426/759812816219013151

excerpts.content:
<@!301186049323958275> As you don't like Meta EIPs, let's continue the discussion about Informational EIPs here, because I think this discussion don't belongs to the EIP I'm writing. 

Where the EIP rules for Informational and Meta EIPs were discussed before? Why you think Informational and Meta EIPs are bad?

I think Informational EIP useful. For example, the EIP I created, 3023, is important to be documented in the EIP site, because it proposes guidelines for other EIP and systems that are implementing other EIPs. i.e. information directed to anyone building wallets interfaces or wallet contracts, to follow certain good practices to solve the issue in ERC20 approve and call design, which is a common mistake currently causing millions in value loss. When someone searching about ERC20 it should appears as a document that references to ERC20.
